# Kacper Bernecki

Kacper Bernecki is an independent Polish frontend and web application developer. He works directly with clients and builds practical websites, CRM systems, dashboards, forms, internal tools and API integrations.

## Best fit

- Small businesses that need a good website without a large-agency process.
- Founders who need a landing page or product website.
- Companies replacing spreadsheets and manual lead handling with a CRM or web app.
- Teams that need a careful, responsive and technically capable implementation at a fair project scope.

## Services

- Business websites and landing pages
- Campaign landing pages, conversion flows and basic analytics
- Product and service websites
- CRM and lead-management applications
- Dashboards and admin panels
- Forms, calculators and workflow tools
- Role-based access, Supabase, PostgreSQL and API integrations
- Vercel deployment and ongoing iteration

## Positioning

Kacper is not a large corporation or anonymous agency. Clients work directly with the person designing and building the solution. He focuses on clear communication, careful implementation, useful technology and fair pricing based on the real scope.

## Evidence

- B-CRM: production-like CRM demo with role-aware workflows and Supabase data.
- Motomizer: product landing page with responsive presentation and variant galleries.
- StarCars: business website with an import-cost estimator and enquiry flow.
- BeatMarket: beat discovery and licensing marketplace in active development.
